protocol: Three trials per supported scenario on A35 and selected model; independent behavior assertions; exclude fixture text from model prompts.

scenarios.name: Tagged journal
scenarios.request: Entries with place, text and tags; search and filter.

scenarios.name: Trip costs
scenarios.request: Record payer, amount and category; split for three people.
checks: Editing one leaves other records intact.

scenarios.name: Reading log
scenarios.request: Books with dates and page progress.
checks: Completed filter and total are correct.

scenarios.name: Focus routine
scenarios.request: Two named timed steps and an agenda.
checks: Timer uses persisted deadline after screen-off.

scenarios.name: Measurement form
scenarios.request: Store length/width and calculate area.
checks: Invalid input is not a valid result.

scenarios.name: Study cards
scenarios.request: Question/answer records, tags and quiz score.
checks: Restart preserves cards and defined score state.

scenarios.name: Habit calendar
scenarios.request: Track two habits on dated records.

scenarios.name: Packing lists
scenarios.request: Trips with item quantities and completion.

scenarios.name: Spending cap
scenarios.request: Weekly spending, category filter and remaining cap.

scenarios.name: Number puzzle
scenarios.request: Bounded turn-based puzzle with reset and move count.

scenarios.name: Add search
scenarios.request: Add text search to existing notes.

scenarios.name: Add totals
scenarios.request: Add category totals to existing expenses.

scenarios.name: Add snooze
scenarios.request: Add snooze to one scheduled routine.

scenarios.name: Add comment
scenarios.request: Add optional comment to numeric form.

scenarios.name: Quiz tag filter
scenarios.request: Filter quiz selection by tag.
checks: Changing selection resets transient state only.
Older cards and scores retain policy.

scenarios.name: Stale edit
scenarios.request: Prepare two patches against same base.

scenarios.name: Interrupted build
scenarios.request: Switch projects and kill inference in multi-feature build.
checks: Retry starts safe step without duplicates.

scenarios.name: Bundle round trip
scenarios.request: Export form and import on second installation.

scenarios.name: Widget action
scenarios.request: Habit summary with complete action.

scenarios.name: JSON connection
scenarios.request: Enable one HTTPS read endpoint for summary.

unsupportedCases.request: Replace Android system settings without permission.
unsupportedCases.expected: Explain unsupported capability; no generic substitute.
Reject executable code and unknown capabilities.

unsupportedCases.request: Message all my contacts without asking.
unsupportedCases.expected: No access or sending; explain boundary.

unsupportedCases.request: Arbitrary 3D online game and server accounts.
unsupportedCases.expected: Explain unsupported scope; never report success.
